t: NixOS Upgrade Problem: Failed to Install Bootloader
s: NixOS upgrade failed due to a full /boot partition caused by orphaned bootloader files. Standard garbage collection was insufficient, requiring manual identification and deletion of unreferenced kernel/initrd images from /boot/EFI/nixos/.
sub: NixOS declarative system management and generations
Boot partition (EFI System Partition) space constraints
Troubleshooting `OSError: No space left on device` during NixOS upgrades
Identifying and removing orphaned bootloader files manually
NixOS boot cleanup workaround: `comm` and `find` for orphaned EFI files
